name: CLAI
tagline: A remote shell that turns plain-language requests into command-line commands, with trusted device pairing.

awards: MLH - Best Use of Gemini API presented by Google Gemini || Mechanical Keyboards

problem: Deploying software and using the command line are hard for many developers.
solution: An Electron app connects verified devices to a remote shell using HMAC trust; Gemini translates intent into commands.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a goal and run the generated command remotely.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best Use of Gemini API presented by Google Gemini || Mechanical Keyboards” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Put a security step in front of any AI that runs commands.
